verdict.rationale: Cal.com documents round-robin scheduling as a core team mode. Its scheduling-configuration API exposes round-robin hosts with priority, weight and group assignment, plus a weights toggle and lead threshold, which directly matches weighted or prioritized fair distribution. A routing trace also shows the host selection logic for each booking. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how the distribution algorithm balances load, hands-on or independent corroboration that weighting and priority keep distribution fair in practice, and evidence beyond a read-only configuration endpoint.

support.subject: As a sales lead, inbound meetings distribute across my team round-robin, with weighting or priority so load stays fair

citations.quote: **roundRobin**: Full configuration including hosts with priority, weight, and group assignment, host groups, and advanced settings (weights toggle, lead threshold, no-show calculations, CRM fallback).
It powers one-on-one, group, round-robin, and collective scheduling
Shows how the booking was routed through routing forms, CRM lookups, and host selection logic.
